20 Assisting in or inducing commission outside United Kingdom of offence
punishable under a corresponding law.
A person commits an offence if in the United Kingdom he assists in or induces the
commission in any place outside the United Kingdom of an offence punishable under
the provisions of a corresponding law in force in that place.

21 Offences by corporations.
Where any offence under this Act [F36or Part II of the Criminal Justice (International
Co-operation) Act 1990 F37... [F38or Article 47 of the Proceeds of Crime (Northern
Ireland) Order 1996 ]] committed by a body corporate is proved to have been
committed with the consent or connivance of, or to be attributable to any neglect
on the part of, any director, manager, secretary or other similar officer of the body
corporate, or any person purporting to act in any such capacity, he as well as the body
corporate shall be guilty of that offence and shall be liable to be proceeded against
accordingly.
